description: Slow-cooked rice and lentils tempered with pure ghee, whole black pepper, curry leaves, and crunchy cashews.
Crisp golden fried banana peppers stuffed with tangy spiced ajwain and lemon.
Succulent cubes of cottage cheese marinated in hung curd, heavy cream, and aromatic garam masala.
Spicy and crunchy deep fried boneless chicken bites tossed with garlic, green chillies, and curry leaves.
Traditional stuffed brinjal curry prepared in a rich peanut and sesame coconut gravy.
Cottage cheese simmered in a silky tomato and cashew butter gravy.
Tangy raw mango dal infused with mustard seed, garlic, and red chili tadka.
Tender mutton cooked with sour roselle leaves, onions, and Andhra rustic spices.
Long grain fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced garden vegetables and saffron milk.
Traditional clay oven baked flatbread brushed with garlic butter.
Warm khoya milk dumplings soaked in cardamom sugar syrup served over chilled reduced saffron milk.
Authentic temple-style rich cashew besan laddus with aromatic edible camphor and green cardamom.
Refreshing churned buttermilk tempered with ginger, green chili, and roasted cumin.
Authentic chicory blended South Indian filter coffee brewed with hot frothy whole milk.
